marketLayer.title: HK Tech Stocks Rally on Enterprise AI Monetization
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.8% led by gains in internet giants following earnings updates highlighting accelerated enterprise cloud and AI service revenue.
marketLayer.inference: Tangible revenue contributions from AI infrastructure are beginning to drive valuation re-ratings for major Chinese tech platforms.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: High capital expenditure commitments impacting near-term free cash flow margins.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor Sector Strengthens on Hyperscaler Capex
marketLayer.fact: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index advanced 1.2% in overnight trading as key server GPU suppliers signaled sustained order backlogs through H2.
marketLayer.inference: AI compute infrastructure spending remains resilient among US cloud providers, supporting strong fundamentals across the hardware supply chain.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Geopolitical risk and potential updates to technology export restrictions.

marketLayer.title: Chinese EV Exporters Gain Traction in Overseas Markets
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed EV manufacturers gained 2.5% on average after several OEMs announced record Q2 international shipment numbers.
marketLayer.inference: Rapid export market growth is effectively buffering domestic price war pressure for leading Chinese electric vehicle brands.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving international trade policies and foreign tariff structures.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Liquidity and Fed Policy Outlook
marketLayer.fact: US Treasury yields drifted lower following labor market cooling indicators, boosting market pricing for a rate cut in the upcoming FOMC meeting.
marketLayer.inference: An easing monetary cycle provides favorable liquidity conditions for risk assets globally, particularly benefiting emerging market equities and HK growth stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Stickiness in core inflation metrics delaying the pace of monetary policy easing.
